description_en: Creates a knowledge base and returns the knowledge base ID, name, ownership, and the access role of the current caller. This operation does not automatically add sources, build knowledge, or generate retrieval results. You can continue to configure knowledge sources and build tasks. The tenant and owner of the knowledge base are determined by the current caller identity. You do not need to specify a workspace or resource group
description_zh: 创建一个知识库，返回知识库 ID、名称、归属及当前调用者的访问角色。创建不会自动添加来源、构建知识或生成检索结果；可继续配置知识来源和构建任务。知识库所属租户和负责人由当前调用身份确定，无需传入工作空间或资源组
name: CreateKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base. This parameter cannot be empty. The maximum length is 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 知识库名称，不能为空。服务端限制最长 128 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 销售指标与业务制度知识。
parameters.help_en: The description of the knowledge base. This parameter is optional. The maximum length is 1024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 知识库描述，可选。服务端限制最长 1024 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The type of the knowledge base. PERSONAL: personal knowledge base. ENTERPRISE: enterprise knowledge base. If this parameter is omitted, the default value is PERSONAL. Creating an enterprise knowledge base requires the corresponding enterprise knowledge base capabilities
parameters.help_zh: 知识库类型。PERSONAL：个人知识库；ENTERPRISE：企业知识库。省略时为 PERSONAL；创建企业知识库需具备相应企业知识库能力
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token for the creation request. This parameter is optional. It accepts up to 64 characters and must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Use the same value when the same caller retries the same creation request in the same region. Reusing a token with different request content returns a conflict. If you omit the token, repeated requests may create multiple knowledge bases
parameters.help_zh: 创建请求的幂等标识，可选，最长 64 个字符且不能是空白字符串。同一调用者在相同地域重试相同创建请求时使用相同值；相同值但请求内容不同会返回冲突。省略时不保证重复请求只创建一个知识库
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The business error code returned when the request fails. This field is not returned when the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的业务错误码；成功时不返回

Data.description_en: The knowledge base information returned upon successful creation
Data.description_zh: 创建成功后返回的知识库信息

AccessRole.description_en: The access role of the current caller for the knowledge base. Upon successful creation, the value is OWNER, which indicates the owner
AccessRole.description_zh: 当前调用者对该知识库的访问角色；创建成功时为 OWNER，表示负责人

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 知识库创建时间，Unix 毫秒级时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the knowledge base. This field may not be returned if it is not set
Description.description_zh: 知识库描述；未设置时可能不返回
Description.example: 销售指标与业务制度知识。

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable knowledge base ID generated by the server. You can use this ID to read the knowledge base, register sources, and create build tasks
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 服务端生成的稳定知识库 ID，可用于读取知识库、登记来源及创建构建任务

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 知识库最近修改时间，Unix 毫秒级时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the knowledge base

Owner.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the knowledge base owner, which is determined by the server based on the caller identity
Owner.description_zh: 知识库负责人的 DataWorks 用户 ID，由服务端根据调用身份确定

Status.description_en: The status of the knowledge base. Upon successful creation, the value is ACTIVE, which indicates that the knowledge base is available for normal use
Status.description_zh: 知识库状态；创建成功时为 ACTIVE，表示可正常使用

Type.description_en: The type of the knowledge base. A value of PERSONAL indicates a personal knowledge base, and a value of ENTERPRISE indicates an enterprise knowledge base
Type.description_zh: 知识库类型：PERSONAL 表示个人知识库，ENTERPRISE 表示企业知识库

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails. This field is not returned when the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误说明；成功时不返回

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
